ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; approximately 75% light-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels across the central and lateral lobe surfaces against 25% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated on trailing edges, distal tips, and the vertical median axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant light-grey contiguous surface with high-contrast black focal spots. Distinct clusters include a group of ~5 circular black spots in the lower-left central quadrant, a thick vertical black band along the median notch axis, and continuous black pigmentation following the trailing edge and tapering into solid black distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped depression with an acute internal pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending roughly 12% into the vertical height of the visible fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular variations along the continuous boundary. Notable peaks and valleys across the inner lobes, with a significant irregular indentation (trauma-related) on the right lobe's trailing edge approximately 40% distance from the center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical curve fitted to the upper leading edges, sweeping outward and upward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of multiple small, roughly circular dark pixel clusters (diameter range 5-15 pixels) distributed across the light ventral surface, with higher density in the lower-central sections of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of several thin, unaligned diagonal dark linear marks on the left lobe surface, disrupting the uniform light-grey pigmentation mapping.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular notch/tissue loss on the trailing edge of the right lobe, distinctive from primary serration patterns.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique trapezoidal configuration of four large, high-contrast circular black spots located in the lower-left quadrant of the left lobe.
